001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.controller;
002
003import android.os.Bundle;
004import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
005import androidx.navigation.NavController;
006import androidx.navigation.fragment.NavHostFragment;
007import androidx.navigation.ui.AppBarConfiguration;
008import androidx.navigation.ui.NavigationUI;
009import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint;
010import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
011import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.databinding.ActivityMainBinding;
012
013/**
014 * MainActivity serves as the primary entry point of the application and acts as the host for
015 * navigation within the app. It is annotated with @AndroidEntryPoint to enable dependency
016 * injection with Hilt. This activity is responsible for setting up and managing the application's
017 * navigation components, including the toolbar and NavController.
018 *
019 * The activity uses a custom toolbar for navigation and integrates it with the navigation
020 * architecture component using AppBarConfiguration and NavController.
021 *
022 * Lifecycle methods:
023 * - onCreate: Initializes the activity, sets up data binding, and calls the navigation setup
024 *   method to configure navigation and toolbar.
025 *
026 * Core methods:
027 * - setupNavigation: Configures the AppBar with the NavController and associates the toolbar
028 *   with the navigation graph, enabling proper navigation between screens.
029 * - onSupportNavigateUp: Handles navigation when the user taps on the up button, delegating
030 *   the action to NavigationUI.
031 *
032 * Note: The activity includes a placeholder for obtaining location permission but it is
033 * currently commented out and marked as a TODO for future implementation.
034 */
035@AndroidEntryPoint
036public class MainActivity extends AppCompatActivity {
037
038
039  private ActivityMainBinding binding;
040  private NavController navController;
041  private AppBarConfiguration appBarConfig;
042
043  @Override
044  protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
045    super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
046    binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(getLayoutInflater());
047    setContentView(binding.getRoot());
048    //Adding our own toolbar
049    setupNavigation();
050  }
051
052  @Override
053  public boolean onSupportNavigateUp() {
054    return NavigationUI.navigateUp(navController, appBarConfig);
055  }
056
057  /**
058   * Configures the application's navigation components, integrating the toolbar with the app's
059   * navigation graph and setting up proper handling of navigation actions.
060   *
061   * This method sets the activity's toolbar as the support ActionBar and establishes an
062   * AppBarConfiguration that defines the top-level destinations within the app's navigation graph.
063   * It retrieves the NavController from the NavHostFragment and binds it to the ActionBar to enable
064   * navigation using the NavController.
065   *
066   * Core responsibilities:
067   * - Sets up the custom toolbar as the ActionBar for the activity.
068   * - Configures an AppBarConfiguration to manage navigation behaviors for top-level destinations.
069   * - Associates the NavController with the ActionBar to synchronize navigation actions and UI behavior.
070   */
071  private void setupNavigation() {
072    setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar);
073    appBarConfig = new AppBarConfiguration.Builder(R.id.home_fragment, R.id.pre_login_fragment, R.id.login_fragment)
074        .build();
075    navController =((NavHostFragment) binding.navHostContainer.getFragment()).getNavController();
076    NavigationUI.setupActionBarWithNavController(this, navController, appBarConfig);
077  }
078}
